basic_info.description: This stunning 1920s Edwardian flat, located in the desirable Alamo Square/NOPA neighborhood, boasts gorgeous hardwood flooring that flows through from entry into the spacious living/dining area. The living room overlooks a beautifully manicured patio/garden area. The remodeled kitchen offers lots of space with new white Shaker cabinets and lovely quartz countertops. The two spacious bedrooms are bright and both have very large walk-in closets. The pristinely remodeled bathroom includes new vanity, light fixtures, and mirrored cabinet. Bathroom also has washer/dryer combo hook-up for convenient in-unit washing. Living room nook can be used as remote office or simply additional storage. Additional highlights of this property include deeded parking, and extra laundry facilities in garage area. The shared garden area is equipped with a BBQ and patio dining set, perfect for outdoor entertaining. Residents will enjoy the proximity to tech buses, Golden Gate Park, and some of the city's best restaurants and coffee shops, all while being tucked away at the rear of the building in a bright peaceful retreat.
